paragraphs: I started editing in 2020 as a hobby, began freelancing in 2021, and turned professional in 2024, with my first real client work coming in 2025–26. My focus is YouTube content, reels, cinematic storytelling and motion graphics.

I collaborate with [Dhruv Thakkar](https://www.youtube.com/@dhruvthakkar2604), a well-known Vadodara YouTuber, editing key segments and recreating archived content with clean cuts and creative visuals.

timeline.text: Began small freelance projects in grading, transitions and pacing.
Deep-dived into After Effects and motion graphics.
Went professional: YouTube, reels and motion work.
Collaboration with Dhruv Thakkar. Launched Meet Editor Studio.
